module: Flowgraph node "On Refueling" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon). Detects career refueling events. Outputs: openedMenu, tankFilled, paidPrice, closedMenu (one-frame impulses), currentlyFueling (flow while filling is in progress, via career_modules_fuel.isCurrentlyFueling) and tankPercent (number, current energy / max energy summed over all tanks).
notes: tankPercent is not updated if getFuelData() returns nil (keeps its last value); division by max without protection if max is 0.

work.desc: Every frame: sets the flow pins back to false, applies the flags, updates currentlyFueling and tankPercent, clears the flags.
